headline: Free tools for a clearer UBC week.
support: A small public toolkit that stays in your browser. Start with Schedule Maker: import Workday Excel, choose courses, export a timetable PNG.
featuredBody: Upload View My Courses, pick what belongs on the grid, restyle the card, and download a PNG. Nothing is uploaded.
excelHowTitle: How to get the Excel from Workday
excelHow3: Under the “View My Courses” title, click the first icon — the one to the left of the PDF icon. That downloads the Excel file.
how1b: The Excel is parsed in this tab. Closing the page does not send the file anywhere.
how2b: Nothing is placed automatically. Check Active courses, add Waitlist as dashed blocks, keep Dropped off.
how3b: PNG captures the timetable card only — not the editors around it.
privacyBody: Schedules live in this browser until you reset them. Workday remains the source of record; always confirm times there.
seoTitle: Timetable Craft — free UBC student tools
seoDescription: Free browser tools for UBC students. Open Schedule Maker to turn Workday Excel into a weekly timetable without uploading your file.
